title: WaxalNLP TTS configs are licence-eligible for ASR training

reviewer.approval_channel: recorded project decision; see repository history for the
reviewer.note: Deliberately no personal identifiers. A licence record is a long-lived artefact that may be shared with partners or auditors; it needs an accountable ROLE and a referenceable decision, not an individual's contact details.

source.readme_note: Fetched at the pinned revision and hashed; licence table read directly, not inferred.

rationale: The adapter assigned allowed_use mechanically from the config's task name:
That is an internal convention derived from WHICH CONFIG WAS PULLED, not from any
licence term. Nothing in the upstream licences distinguishes speech synthesis from
Neither CC BY 4.0 nor CC BY-SA 4.0 contains a field-of-use restriction. Both permit
use, adaptation and redistribution for any purpose, subject to attribution and (for
BY-SA) share-alike on adapted material. A TTS corpus is (text, audio) pairs; the
licence does not care which direction a model learns.
The README's own guidance (line 1114) is that licences differ per language, so this
record binds PER CONFIG rather than making a blanket claim about 'TTS corpora'.
authorizes: ASR TRAINING, internally, on the configs listed below. Nothing else.
does_not_authorize: ASR EVALUATION. These corpora are text-disjoint and same-speaker split; they are
not evidence of speaker-generalising ASR performance. asr_eval is deliberately NOT
Model promotion to approved/ or the serving registry. That remains B5 and manual.
Model distribution. CC BY-SA share-alike and attribution obligations, and voice /
privacy review, are a separate B5 distribution gate (see open_obligations).

configs_authorized.note: CC BY 4.0, NOT share-alike. Attribution still required; no copyleft on adapted material.

PROVIDER DISCREPANCY: the adapter attributes ful_tts to digital_umuganda; the README TTS table lists Fula under Media Trust. Both are CC-BY-SA-4.0, so the licence conclusion is unaffected, but ATTRIBUTION would name the wrong licensor. Must be resolved before distribution.

effect.manifest_change: allowed_use gains 'asr_train'; 'tts_train' and 'tts_eval' retained; 'asr_eval' NOT added.
effect.manifest_versioning: A NEW immutable manifest version is written. v1 is never overwritten.

open_obligations: B5 DISTRIBUTION GATE: CC BY-SA 4.0 share-alike may attach to a model trained on
BY-SA material depending on jurisdiction and on whether the model is an adaptation.
Unresolved. Internal training authorisation does NOT settle distribution.
B5 DISTRIBUTION GATE: attribution must name the correct licensor per corpus. The
ful_tts provider discrepancy above must be resolved first.
B5 DISTRIBUTION GATE: voice / privacy review. These are identifiable human voices;
consent is recorded at dataset level only (consent_id=dataset-level:waxalnlp/*).
EVALUATION: a speaker-disjoint Pidgin ASR evaluation set is still required before
any B5 promotion. TTS-test WER is not a substitute.

licence_permits_asr_training.basis: CC BY 4.0 and CC BY-SA 4.0 impose no field-of-use restriction; read from the README at the pinned revision and hashed.

consent_and_privacy.why: Licence permission is not consent. These are identifiable human voices. consent_id is 'dataset-level:waxalnlp/<provider>' -- a dataset-level assertion, not per-speaker consent for our downstream use. Nothing in this record establishes that the speakers agreed to ASR model training, only that the licence does not forbid it.

distribution.why: CC BY-SA share-alike may attach to a model trained on BY-SA material; attribution must name the correct licensor per corpus; voice/privacy review has not been done.

tracked_issues.title: ful_tts licensor attribution disagrees between adapter and dataset card
tracked_issues.detail: pipeline/adapters/waxalnlp.py maps ful_tts -> digital_umuganda; the README TTS provider table lists Fula under Media Trust. Both are CC-BY-SA-4.0, so licence eligibility is unaffected -- but CC BY-SA requires attributing the correct licensor, so published attribution would name the wrong party.
tracked_issues.resolution_required_before: any distribution or publication of a model or corpus
tracked_issues.does_not_block: internal ASR training under this record
tracked_issues.next_step: Confirm the true licensor for ful_tts with the upstream maintainers, or attribute both providers pending clarification.
